Package library

Class user

java.lang.Object
library.user
Direct Known Subclasses:
Admin, Member
public class user extends Object
Base class for all system users in the library application.

This class is extended by both Admin and Member, providing shared attributes such as ID, username, password, full name, and account status. It also distinguishes whether the user is an admin.

Main Features:

  • User identity information (ID, username, full name)
  • Authentication data (password)
  • Role identification (admin or not)
  • Account status (active or deactivated)
